basic_details.short_information: MOIL Limited, Nagpur (a Government of India Enterprise), has invited applications by post for 2 Advisor posts on contract basis, one each of Advisor (Strategic Planning & Commercial) and Advisor (Management Services), open to retired employees of PSUs, Government Departments, Autonomous Bodies, Institutes and ex-employees of MOIL. Applications go to General Manager (Pers.), MOIL Ltd, MOIL Bhavan, 1-A, Katol Road, Nagpur-440 013 on or before 14/12/2026; the application form is on www.moil.nic.in.

age_limit.details: Up to 65 years as on 14/12/2026 for both posts. Age, experience etc. are counted as on 14/12/2026. The notice prints no age relaxation.

qualification.details: The notice gives the same terms for both posts. Tenure of engagement is 1 year, extendable on the basis of requirement of company. | Retired Executives/Officers from MOIL and other PSUs who have served at the level of E-08/E-09 grades or equivalent of Senior Level Officers of Central/State Government Departments/Autonomous Bodies funded by Government of India/State Government/Academic Institutes, having requisite expertise and professional competence of their work of domain. Desirable experience: (a) Sales & Marketing / Materials / Business Development etc.; (b) experience of working with Senior Management is an added advantage. All qualifications should be recognized by AICTE / UGC / appropriate Indian Statutory Authorities. | Up to 65 years as on 14/12/2026 for both posts. Age, experience etc. are counted as on 14/12/2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. | A consolidated amount of maximum 50% of last drawn Basic and 50% of DA element is considered as fixed special allowance. In addition, an allowance of 5% (on 50% of Basic pay) of remuneration is paid to cover expenses of conveyance, telephone, internet etc. Company accommodation may be provided, subject to availability. Where company accommodation is not available, HRA is paid at 30%, 20% and 10% of the consolidated remuneration for X, Y and Z class cities, respectively. | For the official detail of each post's eligibility, refer to the official notification.

selection_process: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Merely meeting the qualifications and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called. TA/DA for the interview is paid as per the applicant's entitlement at the time of retirement. The notice does not describe the interview further.
important_instructions: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Mere submission of an application does not give a right to claim appointment. Candidates need an active e-mail ID and mobile number valid for at least the next 6 months. All future communication will be only through e-mail. The Advisor engaged must be medically fit, as declared by the Doctor in charge of MOIL, Nagpur. There will be no employer-employee relationship between MOIL and the Advisor. Advisors are not entitled to medical reimbursement or benefits such as EPF, Gratuity etc. Management may terminate the engagement with 15 days' notice; the Advisor may terminate it with one month's notice. False or incorrect information can lead to rejection of candidature at any stage. Canvassing in any form disqualifies the candidature. MOIL reserves the right to cancel, curtail or increase the number of posts without notice or reason. Any modification, amendment or corrigendum will be given only on www.moil.nic.in. Disputes are settled within the jurisdiction of Nagpur only. Queries can be sent to [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About MOIL
content_sections.text: MOIL Limited is a Schedule 'A' Miniratna Category-I PSU under the Ministry of Steel, Government of India, with its office at MOIL Bhavan, Nagpur. The notice describes it as the largest Manganese ore producer in the country, operating ten mines in Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh. It plans to expand production capacity to 3.50 million tonnes by 2030.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application to: General Manager (Pers.), MOIL Ltd, MOIL Bhavan, 1-A, Katol Road, Nagpur-440 013, on or before 14/12/2026. Write 'Application for engagement of------------------' on the envelope, filling in the post applied for. The notice does not name a postal mode. Download the application form from the MOIL website, www.moil.nic.in . The form is also printed in the notice (pages 5 to 7). Fill in the form, including a recent passport size photo, qualification and experience details, languages known, and the signed declaration. Attach self-attested copies of certificates and testimonials. Super-scribe the envelope as shown above and send it to the General Manager (Pers.) at the address given. The management takes no responsibility for any delay in receipt or loss in postal transit of an application or communication.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice gives the same terms for both posts. Tenure of engagement is 1 year, extendable on the basis of requirement of company. Retired Executives/Officers from MOIL and other PSUs who have served at the level of E-08/E-09 grades or equivalent of Senior Level Officers of Central/State Government Departments/Autonomous Bodies funded by Government of India/State Government/Academic Institutes, having requisite expertise and professional competence of their work of domain. Desirable experience: (a) Sales & Marketing / Materials / Business Development etc.; (b) experience of working with Senior Management is an added advantage. All qualifications should be recognized by AICTE / UGC / appropriate Indian Statutory Authorities. Up to 65 years as on 14/12/2026 for both posts. Age, experience etc. are counted as on 14/12/2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. A consolidated amount of maximum 50% of last drawn Basic and 50% of DA element is considered as fixed special allowance. In addition, an allowance of 5% (on 50% of Basic pay) of remuneration is paid to cover expenses of conveyance, telephone, internet etc. Company accommodation may be provided, subject to availability. Where company accommodation is not available, HRA is paid at 30%, 20% and 10% of the consolidated remuneration for X, Y and Z class cities, respectively. For the official detail of each post's eligibility, refer to the official notification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MOIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: 1 Advisor (Strategic Planning & Commercial) and 1 Advisor (Management Services). MOIL may cancel, curtail or increase the number of posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MOIL Advisor posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent on or before 14/12/2026 to General Manager (Pers.), MOIL Ltd, MOIL Bhavan, 1-A, Katol Road, Nagpur-440 013.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for the MOIL Advisor posts?
faq.answer: Retired Executives/Officers from MOIL and other PSUs who served at E-08/E-09 grades, or equivalent Senior Level Officers of Central/State Government Departments, Autonomous Bodies or Academic Institutes, with expertise in their domain. Only Indian Nationals can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for MOIL Advisor?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 65 years as on 14/12/2026 for both posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for MOIL Advisor?
faq.answer: The pay is a consolidated amount of maximum 50% of last drawn Basic and 50% of DA element, plus a 5% allowance on 50% of Basic. The grade-wise pay scales are E-08: 120000-280000 and E-09: 150000-300000.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for MOIL Advisor?
faq.answer: Download the form from www.moil.nic.in, fill it in, attach self-attested copies of certificates and send it by post to General Manager (Pers.), Nagpur, with 'Application for engagement of------------------' on the envelope.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Meeting the qualifications and experience alone does not entitle a candidate to be called.

faq.question: Q8. Can retired employees apply, and how is their pay fixed?
faq.answer: Yes, retired employees of PSUs, Government Departments, Autonomous Bodies, Institutes and ex-employees of MOIL can apply. Pay is a consolidated amount linked to 50% of last drawn Basic and 50% of DA element.

faq.question: Q9. Is the MOIL Advisor post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract engagement for 1 year, extendable on the basis of requirement of company, with no employer-employee relationship. EPF, Gratuity and medical reimbursement are not given.

faq.question: Q10. Is HRA paid with the MOIL Advisor remuneration?
faq.answer: Company accommodation may be provided, subject to availability. Otherwise HRA is paid at 30%, 20% and 10% of the consolidated remuneration for X, Y and Z class cities respectively.
